        categoryperf,
        CASE WHEN categoryperf > 0 THEN 'up' ELSE 'down' END AS market_condition

    WHERE fundperf IS NOT NULL AND categoryperf IS NOT NULL
),
fund_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        portfolioref,
        COUNT(*) as num_years,

    FROM fund_outperformance
    GROUP BY portfolioref
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)

    ROUND((COALESCE(avg_upside_outperformance, 0) - COALESCE(avg_downside_outperformance, 0))::numeric, 4) AS capture_differential

ORDER BY capture_differential DESC;

        portfolioref,
        fundperf - categoryperf AS outperformance,
        categoryperf,
        CASE WHEN categoryperf > 0 THEN 'up' ELSE 'down' END AS market_condition
    FROM annual_returns
    WHERE fundperf IS NOT NULL AND categoryperf IS NOT NULL
),
fund_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        portfolioref,
        AVG(CASE WHEN market_condition = 'up' THEN outperformance END) AS avg_upside_outperformance,
        AVG(CASE WHEN market_condition = 'down' THEN outperformance END) AS avg_downside_outperformance,
        (AVG(CASE WHEN market_condition = 'up' THEN outperformance END) - AVG(CASE WHEN market_condition = 'down' THEN outperformance END)) AS capture_differential
    FROM fund_outperformance
    GROUP BY portfolioref
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN market_condition = 'up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN market_condition = 'down' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT portfolioref, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY capture_differential DESC) AS fund_rank

)
